The EXPECT rows are what stops the guard from being satisfied by a dead pass: `LocalEmbed.Close -> Writer.Close` is a genuine same-file shadow of the very same local type through an unqualified embed, so an implementation that refused every embed would fail here rather than pass by refusing the fabricated one. `OnlyEmbeds` embeds `io.Reader` and declares nothing: the empty-closure control on the qualified side.
